name: G'MIC
description: G'MIC's filters and your own G'MIC scripts as Develop panels: install them from the G'MIC store, preview them live on the photo, and every export applies them. Also runs G'MIC from the Terminal and the safelight command line. Uses the gmic program you install from gmic.eu.
author: Anthony Reimche

permissions.reason: Runs the gmic program you choose on your photos, to preview G'MIC's filters and scripts in Develop and apply them when you export. Reads gmic.eu's download page to link the newest G'MIC for Windows.

commands.name: gmic
commands.summary: Run G'MIC filters and scripts on photos, each result saved beside its photo

subcommands.name: filters
subcommands.summary: List G'MIC's filters, or those matching a search

subcommands.name: filter
subcommands.summary: Run a filter by name, with Name=value settings

subcommands.name: script
subcommands.summary: Run a saved script by name, with Name=value settings

subcommands.name: run
subcommands.summary: Run G'MIC words, even ones named like a subcommand

subcommands.name: help
subcommands.summary: G'MIC's own help for one of its commands

subcommands.name: status
subcommands.summary: Which gmic program runs, and its version
